verdict.rationale: Ubuntu's official documentation lists a dedicated 'Encrypt your disk with TPM' guide, with sections on configuring hardware-backed disk encryption and recovering data from it. That is first-party evidence that TPM-backed full-disk encryption is a supported feature. The evidence consists only of table-of-contents headings, though, so its depth is not shown. Missing for 10: detailed doc content (installer flow, hardware/TPM requirements, maturity or experimental status), independent or hands-on corroboration that it works in practice.
